name: mod-call
prompt: The background is pure flat black and completely empty for the entire shot. No room, no floor, no horizon, no objects, no text, no logos, no numbers, no people. Only the glowing element described, isolated on black, as if shot in a blacked-out void. A glowing warm amber audio waveform, a symmetrical row of thin vertical bars, oscillating continuously in the centre of the frame; the bars then settle and collapse smoothly down into three calm horizontal glowing lines stacked one above another. Continuous and steady. Static locked-off camera. Extremely dark, high contrast. No text, no numbers, no labels.
